title: Request fails after network timeout
content: The application request hangs and then fails when the network connection is interrupted or the server responds too slowly.
resolution: Check timeout handling, retry policy, and connection cleanup.

title: Null pointer while processing request
content: A request handler raises a NullPointerException when an optional field is missing from the incoming request.
resolution: Validate optional fields and handle null values before dereferencing.

title: Editor freezes when opening a large file
content: The editor becomes unresponsive while opening a large file because expensive work runs on the user interface thread.
resolution: Profile the operation and move expensive work off the UI thread with progress and cancellation support.

title: Query fails for empty input
content: A database query fails when an empty input value is passed without validation.
resolution: Validate input and use parameterized queries with explicit empty-value handling.
